manual_web_review.method: Manual public web search/open. Eight new full publisher letter bodies (Letters 642–649) and one existing letter body (AID 2187392) were inspected. The eight new pages explicitly credit Eli Touger as translator and are recorded as non-independent, one Evidence Family per underlying letter. Nine shell redirects, nine inaccessible pages and one HTTP 429 were excluded; alternative direct publisher pages were inspected in the same run. No crawler retry, access-control bypass or full-text copying.
manual_web_review.deduplication_check: Exact AID searches in the repository and review queue found no matches for the eight new AIDs; the review queue contained no matching AID/URL. Existing AID 2187392 was found in batch 070 and enriched in place, not counted as new. The public-search-index file returned an empty oversized response through the connector, so final index-level reconciliation remains authoritative for duplicate detection.
limitations: כל שמונת המקורות החדשים הם תרגומים אנגליים מאת Eli Touger; המקור העברי/יידי והאוטוגרף לא נבדקו. כל תרגום סומן כעד לא עצמאי, והמשפחה הוגדרה לפי המכתב המקורי.
